title: Guided tour with audio provided
text:
We had a guided tour in Alhambra (3 hr) plus the Albaicin Community  (where we had time for a great lunch at the Nazaries). Our guide was so helpful.  Audio was provided with new headsets.  Our group size was very manageable.  There is also a gift shop we stopped at mid way through the Alhambra tour. The Alhambra is seriously amazing!!  

The bus ride was comfortable ( halfway way stop at gift shop / restroom / cafe). We had ability to charge our phones on the bus with usb ports.

This was a very pleasant and memorable experience!!

title: Essential guided visit
text: Highly recommended, a place full of stories that need to be told and for this it is essential to hire a guide. In our case we had the tickets and then we hired the guide. We had an excellent one named Alain who guided the group in two languages, English and Spanish, answering all our questions and contributing all his knowledge.
